components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Advances the current production stage; use once per local action region.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M14 7l5 5-5 5"/></svg>Tạo góc nội dung</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:43px;padding:0 17px;border:1px solid var(--gold,#f2c94c);border-radius:10px;background:var(--gold,#f2c94c);color:var(--gold-dark,#171407);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}.ds-btn-primary svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#ffda61;border-color:#ffda61}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(0)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(242,201,76,.9);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.44;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action for reversible navigation and starting a new run.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Phiên mới</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{min-height:43px;padding:0 17px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3b4855);border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#f7f4ea);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}.ds-btn-ghost svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#222d39;border-color:#526170}.ds-btn-ghost:active{transform:translateY(0)}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(242,201,76,.9);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Prompt Field
components.description: Unified topic-entry surface with textarea, character count, and stage action.
components.html: 0 / 300
components.css: .ds-prompt-label{display:block;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--ink,#f7f4ea);font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.ds-prompt{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#3b4855);border-radius:15px;background:var(--panel,#121821);color:var(--ink,#f7f4ea);font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;transition:border-color .18s ease}.ds-prompt:focus-within{border-color:var(--gold,#f2c94c)}.ds-prompt textarea{box-sizing:border-box;display:block;width:100%;min-height:132px;padding:22px 24px;border:0;outline:0;resize:vertical;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:400 17px/1.65 'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-prompt textarea::placeholder{color:#6f7c89}.ds-prompt-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 13px 12px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#293440)}.ds-prompt-footer span{color:var(--muted,#9aa8b6);font-size:11px}.ds-prompt-footer button{min-height:43px;padding:0 17px;border:1px solid var(--gold,#f2c94c);border-radius:10px;background:var(--gold,#f2c94c);color:var(--gold-dark,#171407);font:700 13px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-prompt-footer button:hover{background:#ffda61;border-color:#ffda61}.ds-prompt-footer button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(242,201,76,.9);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Active Workflow Step
components.description: Shows the current position in the four-stage production sequence.
components.css: .ds-workflow-step{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:13px 9px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#1b2430;color:var(--ink,#f7f4ea);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .18s ease,color .18s ease}.ds-workflow-step:hover{background:#222d39}.ds-workflow-step:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(242,201,76,.9);outline-offset:3px}.ds-step-marker{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 29px;height:29px;border:1px solid var(--gold,#f2c94c);border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold,#f2c94c);color:var(--gold-dark,#171407);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.ds-workflow-step strong,.ds-workflow-step small{display:block}.ds-workflow-step strong{font-size:13px}.ds-workflow-step small{margin-top:1px;font-size:11px;opacity:.7}

components.name: Rundown Row
components.description: Ruled, directional row used for quick starts and other concise choices.
components.css: .ds-rundown-row{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:16px 8px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#293440);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#293440);background:transparent;color:var(--soft,#c6d0d8);display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr 24px;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-align:left;font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .16s ease,color .16s ease,transform .16s ease}.ds-rundown-row span{color:var(--muted,#9aa8b6);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-rundown-row strong{font-size:14px}.ds-rundown-row svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-rundown-row:hover{background:#121a23;color:var(--ink,#f7f4ea);transform:translateX(3px)}.ds-rundown-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(242,201,76,.9);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Vertical Preview
components.description: 9:16 output object with a skeletal ranking placeholder before rendering.
components.html: Video sẽ xuất hiện ở đây sau khi render.
components.css: .ds-preview{box-sizing:border-box;position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:260px;aspect-ratio:9/16;padding:44px 22px 28px;border-radius:16px;background:#161c24;color:#818d99;display:flex;flex-direction:column;font:400 11px/1.55 'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 24px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}.ds-preview-title{width:78%;height:12px;margin:0 auto 9px;border-radius:3px;background:#e7e2d3}.ds-preview-subtitle{width:48%;height:6px;margin:0 auto 30px;border-radius:3px;background:#707b86}.ds-preview-list{border-top:1px solid #3a4652}.ds-preview-list i{display:block;height:32px;border-bottom:1px solid #33404c;position:relative}.ds-preview-list i:before,.ds-preview-list i:after{content:'';position:absolute;top:12px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:#697580}.ds-preview-list i:before{left:3px;width:48%}.ds-preview-list i:after{right:3px;width:25%}.ds-preview p{margin:auto 0 0;text-align:center}

narrative.overview: Ranking Studio behaves like a focused production desk: dark, quiet, and organized around one linear handoff from topic to finished video. Horizontal rules, compact metadata, and numbered checkpoints create the feel of a working rundown. Warm ivory carries the reading voice, cool blue grays carry supporting information, and the gold accent appears only where the operator should act or orient themselves.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy workspace with subtle tonal separation between structural regions.
Warm ivory typography rendered exclusively in Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese coverage.
Ruled lists and tables that read like production paperwork.
Gold reserved for the active step, the main action, and small progress cues.
Compact semantic colors for success, errors, forecasts, and source links.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Gold belongs to one dominant action or active state within a local region. Its scarcity is what makes the workflow easy to scan.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Prefer border lines and tonal changes to boxed cards when organizing related rows, metadata, or review content.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Be Vietnam Pro throughout the product, including numeric and compact metadata roles; use weight and spacing instead of adding another family.

rules.name: The Flat Workflow Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and borders for navigation, forms, tables, and lists. Reserve substantial shadow for previewed output.

dos: Do keep gold concentrated on the current state and the action that advances the workflow.
Do organize repeated content with horizontal rules, compact rows, and shared alignment.
Do preserve the three-region desktop reading order and the sticky workflow strip on mobile.
Do use semantic mint, red, and blue only when the status or source meaning is real.
Do keep all Vietnamese interface text in Be Vietnam Pro with the bundled Vietnamese font files.
donts: Don't turn workflow content into a grid of floating statistic cards.
Don't add gradients, decorative glass effects, or large shadows to ordinary working surfaces.
Don't use gold as a general decoration or on several competing actions in the same region.
Don't hide locked steps; reduced opacity communicates the complete process and current position.
Don't show the desktop preview rail below the established tablet breakpoint or compress it beside the mobile workspace.
